articles.title: Hezbollah rejects renewed ceasefire agreed by Israel and Lebanon
articles.description: The United States announced the ceasefire agreement on Wednesday night following a fresh round of talks.

articles.title: US House delivers rebuke to Trump as it votes to halt Iran war
articles.description: In the 215-208 vote, four Republicans joined Democrats to pass the measure, which is largely symbolic.

articles.title: Israeli strikes kill 11 people in Gaza City, medics say
articles.description: Women and children were among those killed when Israeli aircraft struck at least four residential buildings in several areas.

articles.title: Heavy gunfire in Somali capital as row over election delay escalates
articles.description: The opposition has called for protests after the president's term in office was extended by a year.

articles.title: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
articles.description: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.
